verdict.rationale: Simular's own docs say a taught workflow can rerun on a schedule, which is a time-based automatic trigger, and saved workflows can be replayed as parameterized skills. Nothing shows user-defined rules that fire actions on events (an incoming email, a file change, an app state). missing for 10: event-based trigger definitions, a rule/condition authoring interface, documented trigger types beyond scheduling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
